title: Cleaning for Grandma
setting: A bright living room with a wooden floor.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow T-shirt

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater

sentences.en: At two p.m., Zoe and Raj start cleaning.
sentences.zh: 下午两点，佐伊和拉吉开始打扫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow T-shirt and Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater pick up brooms and cloths in a bright living room in the afternoon sun.

sentences.en: Grandma turns sixty tomorrow and will come for lunch.
sentences.zh: 奶奶明天六十岁，要来吃午饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow T-shirt and Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater look at a framed photo of a smiling grandmother next to a birthday cake.

sentences.en: At the beginning, Raj works very fast.
sentences.zh: 一开始，拉吉干得非常快。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater rushes around the living room with a duster in each hand.

sentences.en: He moves the low table to clean the floor.
sentences.zh: 他挪开矮桌子来打扫地板。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater pushes a low coffee table aside on a wooden floor.

sentences.en: He makes a mistake and drops a dirty cup.
sentences.zh: 他一不小心，把一个脏杯子掉了下去。
sentences.scene_prompt: A dirty cup slips from the hand of Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater and falls.

sentences.en: The cup falls right on his left foot.
sentences.zh: 杯子正好砸在他的左脚上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater hops on one leg holding his left foot, a cup on the floor.

sentences.en: Zoe sends him to sit down for a second.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow T-shirt points to the sofa and Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater sits down with a sigh.

sentences.en: "That is the third cup today!" she laughs.
sentences.zh: “这是今天的第三个杯子了！”她笑着说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short brown hair and a yellow T-shirt laughs and holds up a cup while Raj, a young boy with black hair and a blue sweater smiles shyly on the sofa.
